headword: お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}でした
gloss: thank you for your work (when it is finished); goodbye (at the end of the day)

definitions.gloss: thank you for your work; good job; goodbye (said when work or a task is finished)
definitions.explanation: The past form of お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}, said to someone who has finished a piece of work, a meeting, an event, or the working day, and as the standard farewell when colleagues part. It is the usual reply to お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}でした。
examples.english: Thank you for your work today.

examples.japanese: 「⟦お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します→お先に失礼します：20527_osakinishitsureishimasu⟧」「お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}でした」
examples.english: 'Excuse me for leaving first.' 'Good work today, see you.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧、お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}でした。⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{休|やす}んで→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for sitting through that long meeting. Please get some rest.

notes:
USAGE:
- お{疲|つか}れさまです: to someone still working, as a greeting during the day
- お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}でした: to someone whose work is over, and as a goodbye
- Both are said in every direction, to superiors as well as juniors; ⟦ご{苦労|くろう}{様|さま}→ご苦労様：18374_gokurousama⟧でした is only for subordinates

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}でした: thank you for another full day
- ⟦{皆|みな}さん→皆さん：02971_minasan⟧、お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}でした: thank you all (closing an event)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}→お疲れ様：05208_otsukaresama⟧: the base form, also used casually as お⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧
- お{疲|つか}れさまです: the present form
- ⟦お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します→お先に失礼します：20527_osakinishitsureishimasu⟧: excuse me for leaving first — the phrase this one answers
